name: Last on Mars
source:
A woman struggles with being the last surviving human from the world's first trip to Mars. Will she ever be saved? And if she had the chance to go back to earth, would she?

- Explore an underground space station.
- One tricky puzzle.
- One smashing activity.
- Two different endings.
- Discover something new each time you play (maybe).
- Learn a few bits of science trivia.

Would you consider spending the rest of your life on Mars?

[From [url=http://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/622597]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
一名妇女努力成为世界首次火星之旅中最后一个幸存的人类。她会得救吗？如果她有机会回到地球，她会吗？

- 探索地下空间站。
- 一个棘手的谜题。
- 一项精彩活动。
- 两个不同的结局。
- 每次玩时都会发现新的东西（也许）。
- 学习一些科学知识。

你会考虑在火星上度过余生吗？

[来自[url=http://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/622597]新场地[/url]]
